name: Refrigerator Repair
line: Warm fridge, frost on the back wall, water under the crisper drawers, or a compressor that clicks and quits.

name: Freezer & Ice Maker Repair
line: Soft ice cream, frozen-over evaporator coils, and ice makers that jam, leak, or stop filling.

name: Washer Repair
line: Standing water in the drum, a door that won't unlock, loud spin cycles, and leaks onto the floor.

name: Dryer Repair
line: Drums that turn without heat, clothes that take two cycles, squealing belts, and burning smells.

name: Dishwasher Repair
line: Water left in the tub, dishes still dirty, error codes, and leaks from the door seal.

name: Oven & Range Repair
line: Ovens that won't hold temperature, burners that won't light, and dead bake or broil elements.

name: Microwave Repair
line: Runs but doesn't heat, sparks inside, a dead keypad, or a turntable that stopped turning.

name: Garbage Disposal Repair
line: Hums but won't spin, trips the reset button, leaks under the sink, or drains slowly.
